languages/go/02-core/input-validation/ex.reason: Keeps scanner recovery, range validation, retry behavior, and final aggregation in one traceable console workflow.
languages/go/02-core/input-validation/ex.review_when: Split only if the entrypoint exceeds the level threshold by more than 50 percent or introduces a second domain task.

languages/cpp/02-core/input-validation/e.reason: Keeps stream recovery, range validation, retry behavior, and the final accepted value in one traceable input loop.
languages/cpp/02-core/input-validation/e.review_when: Split if validation gains a second input domain or the recovery path can be demonstrated independently.

languages/csharp/02-core/input-validatio.reason: Keeps parsing, retry prompts, range checks, and successful state transition visible in one console workflow.
languages/csharp/02-core/input-validatio.review_when: Extract a helper when another validated field would otherwise duplicate the loop.

languages/go/02-core/algorithms-basics/e.reason: The side-by-side traversal, filtering, accumulation, and lookup operations form one deliberately comparable data pass.
languages/go/02-core/algorithms-basics/e.review_when: Split if another algorithm family is added or the comparison no longer fits one screen per operation.

languages/go/02-core/file-io-basics/exam.reason: Write, close, reopen, scan, error check, and cleanup are kept together so resource order remains observable.
languages/go/02-core/file-io-basics/exam.review_when: Extract helpers if a second file format or unrelated transformation is introduced.

languages/java/03-advanced/copy-and-move.reason: Java needs one cohesive comparison of aliasing, defensive copying, and explicit transfer-by-convention to avoid implying C++ move syntax exists on the JVM.
languages/java/03-advanced/copy-and-move.review_when: Revisit if a companion example can preserve the direct side-by-side comparison.

languages/java/03-advanced/structs-and-c.reason: The record and guarded class deliberately share one scenario so learners can compare lightweight data with behavior-rich objects.
languages/java/03-advanced/structs-and-c.review_when: Revisit if either model gains additional unrelated behavior.
